title: Youjo Senki: Sabaku no Pasta Daisakusen

alternative_titles.en: Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta
alternative_titles.ja: 幼女戦記 砂漠のパスタ大作戦

synopsis:
At the Empire's southern frontline, Tanya von Degurechaff and her battalion are exhausted by the scorching sun and the lack of rations. So when the battalion suddenly receives a large amount of pasta from headquarters, the group's morale quickly rises. However, without enough water, they are not able to prepare the pasta.

Soon, the battalion discovers an adequate amount of water after a successful reconnaissance mission. Although the troops can now eat something they have not been able to in a long time, something still seems missing. Motivated to give more flavor to the pasta, Tanya and her battalion set out to gather more supplies from their next operation.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
